**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **Renewal mechanic:** none. The term is evergreen from signature "until terminated by either party pursuant to Paragraph 6" (p0011). A document-wide search for "renew" / "extend" returns nothing, so there is no automatic renewal, no renewal term length, and no non-renewal notice window to measure against the 30/60/90-day thresholds.
- **Exit:** § 6(a) gives either party termination for convenience on **15 days'** notice whenever no SOW is outstanding — shorter than the preferred 30 days.
- **Direction check:** ongoing commitment arises only if we sign a new Statement of Work, i.e. effectively "renewal only by mutual written agreement," which is the preferred position. Flagging here would attack a term that benefits us.
- **Noted, not flagged:** § 3(b) permits Contractor to "change rates with 30 days notice" without a CPI/3–5% cap. That is a mid-term pricing right rather than a renewal uplift, so I've left it to the pricing/rate-increase rule to avoid double-flagging the same commercial term; it is partly mitigated by per-SOW rates and our 15-day exit.
